ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Awards can strengthen people’s commitment to the organization giving the award. The intrinsic motivation to perform well and in the interest of the employer is praised by the giver and hence reinforced. In contrast, when an attempt is made to measure performance by pay, this intrinsic work motivation may well be crowded out. After all, performance pay may unintentionally signal that the ultimate goal of all endeavours is to get money. All that matters is to reach the criteria in order to get the bonus promised. The content of work becomes primary . Employees are induced to disregard everything not covered by the criteria imposed — even if they know this is bad for the organization they work for. Moreover, employees promised bonuses have a strong incentive to exploit the system. If shareholder value is used as the major criterion for CEOs, they may artificially increase this number by short-term manipulations or by buying back shares. The resulting shareholder value then does not reflect the underlying state of the corporation but may be biased in favour of short-run effects. * shareholder value 주주 가치

After all, performance pay may unintentionally signal that the ultimate goal of all endeavours is to get money. All that matters is to reach the criteria in order to get the bonus promised. The content of work becomes primary . Employees are induced to (C)[disregard / consider] everything not covered by the criteria imposed — even if they know this is bad for the organization they work for. Moreover, employees promised bonuses have a strong incentive to exploit the system. If shareholder value is used as the major criterion for CEOs, they may artificially increase this number by short-term manipulations or by buying back shares. The resulting shareholder value then does not reflect the underlying state of the corporation but may be biased in favour of short-run effects. * shareholder value 주주 가치
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① strengthen — reinforced — disregard ←정답

② weaken — reinforced — disregard: (A)에 weaken(약화시키다)은 부적절. 본문은 상이 조직에 대한 헌신을 '강화(strengthen)'한다는 내용.

③ strengthen — undermined — disregard: (B)에 undermined(약화된)는 부적절. 내재적 동기가 칭찬받아 '강화(reinforced)'된다는 맥락.

④ strengthen — reinforced — consider: (C)에 consider(고려하다)는 부적절. 직원들이 기준에 해당하지 않는 것은 모두 '무시(disregard)'하게 된다는 맥락.

④ praised — unintentionally — safeguard: (C)에 safeguard(보호하다)는 부적절. 직원들이 시스템을 '악용(exploit)'할 동기가 있다는 맥락.

② crowded out — suggested — biased: (B)에 suggested(제안된)는 부적절. 기준이 외부에서 '부과된(imposed)' 것이라는 맥락.

③ crowded out — imposed — balanced: (C)에 balanced(균형 잡힌)는 부적절. 주주 가치가 단기 효과에 '편향(biased)'될 수 있다는 맥락.

det.analysis:

③ induced(유도된): 직원들이 기준 밖의 것을 무시하도록 '유도된다'는 맥락에 적절.

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 interest가 본문에서와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?

det.analysis:
본문: 'in the interest of the employer(고용주의 이익을 위해)'에서 interest = 이익, 이해관계.

(A) 'protect the financial interest of the investors(투자자들의 재정적 이익을 보호)'에서 interest = 이익. ← 본문과 동일한 의미.

(B) 'showed great interest in the science experiment(과학 실험에 큰 관심을 보였다)'에서 interest = 흥미, 관심. ← 본문과 다른 의미.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided"

det.korean: 기준(criterion): 무언가를 판단하거나 결정하는 기준이나 원칙
det.analysis:
① incentive(유인): 행동을 유발하는 것으로, 판단 기준과 무관.

② criterion(기준) ←정답: '무언가를 판단하거나 결정하는 기준이나 원칙'과 정확히 일치.

③ endeavour(노력): 열심히 시도하는 것으로, 판단 기준과 무관.

④ commitment(헌신): 책임감을 가지고 전념하는 것으로, 판단 기준과 무관.

questions.passage: The intrinsic motivation to perform well and in the interest of the employer is praised by the giver and hence __________ (reinforce). In contrast, when an attempt is made to measure performance by pay, this intrinsic work motivation may well be crowded out.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: reinforce → reinforced (과거분사: is praised and hence reinforced 수동태 병렬)
det.analysis: 'is praised... and hence __________ (reinforce)': 'is praised'와 병렬 구조. be동사(is) + 과거분사(praised) 수동태이므로, hence 뒤에도 과거분사 reinforced가 와야 함.
det.tip: is praised and hence reinforced (수동태 병렬)

questions.passage: If shareholder value is used as the major criterion for CEOs, they may artificially increase this number by short-term __________ (manipulate) or by buying back shares. The resulting shareholder value then does not reflect the underlying state of the corporation but may be biased in favour of short-run effects.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 'by short-term __________ (manipulate)': 전치사 by 뒤에 명사가 필요. short-term(형용사)이 수식하므로 명사형 manipulations(조작)가 와야 함. 동사 manipulate를 명사 manipulation(s)으로 변환.

questions.passage: Awards can strengthen people’s commitment to the organization giving the award. The intrinsic motivation to perform well and in the interest of the employer is praised by the giver and hence reinforced. In contrast, when an attempt is made to measure performance by pay, this intrinsic work motivation may well be __________. After all, performance pay may unintentionally signal that the ultimate goal of all endeavours is to get money. All that matters is to reach the criteria in order to get the bonus promised. The content of work becomes primary . Employees are induced to disregard everything not covered by the criteria imposed — even if they know this is bad for the organization they work for. Moreover, employees promised bonuses have a strong incentive to exploit the system. If shareholder value is used as the major criterion for CEOs, they may artificially increase this number by short-term manipulations or by buying back shares. The resulting shareholder value then does not reflect the underlying state of the corporation but may be biased in favour of short-run effects. * shareholder value 주주 가치
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① carried out(수행하다): 동기가 '수행된다'는 의미는 문맥과 맞지 않음.

② crowded out(밀려나다) ←정답: 앞 문장에서 상은 동기를 강화하지만, 대조적으로(In contrast) 성과급은 동기를 '밀어낸다'는 문맥.

③ pointed out(지적하다): 동기가 '지적된다'는 의미는 부적절.

④ figured out(알아내다): 동기가 '알아내진다'는 의미는 부적절.
det.tip: intrinsic motivation may well be crowded out

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① in spite of(~에도 불구하고): biased in spite of는 비문법적 결합.

② in terms of(~의 관점에서): biased in terms of는 자연스러운 표현이 아님.

③ in favour of(~에 유리하게) ←정답: biased in favour of = ~에 유리하게 편향된. 단기 효과에 유리하게 편향된다는 문맥에 적절.

④ in search of(~를 찾아서): biased in search of는 비문법적 결합.
det.tip: biased in favour of short-run effects
